title: Heritable eating-rate trait carried by the Flow-Lenia predators' conserved matter (mass-weighted, mixed at fusions, trait-blind mutation), selective vs neutral arm
summary: c62's S-claim world plus a trait mass advected with predator matter; digestion rate scales with the local trait in the selective arm and not in the neutral arm; mutations every 20 t in a 6 px disk centred on a random predator pixel. Seeds 1 and 2, t=3000: trait mean and spread over time.
